theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let C_i := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let d_is := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩
  have h_arith : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    have h1 : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_is - 1 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
    have e1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - ↑i := by omega
    have e2 : ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ - ↑i := by omega
    have h2 : (d_is - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
      dsimp only [d_is, d_i, BBF_CodeDistance]
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add, e1, e2]
    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← h2]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Nat.zero_le _)
  have h_pos : 0 < d_i := by dsimp only [d_i, BBF_CodeDistance]; omega
  obtain ⟨g', hg', hgd⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i,
      d_fw = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr ⟨(0 : C_i), Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    exact ⟨g, g.property, hg.symm⟩
  -- each bad fiber holds at most `2 ^ steps` bad points
  have h_count : hammingDist f g' ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    let Y : Set _ := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    haveI : Fintype Y := Fintype.ofFinite Y
    let Δ : Finset _ := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x)
    let iq (x : ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩))
        : ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩) :=
      iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
    let kOf (x : ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩)) : Fin (2 ^ steps) :=
      pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (x := x)
    let fib (y : ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩))
        : Fin (2 ^ steps) → ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩) :=
      qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) (y := y)
    have hrec : ∀ x, fib (iq x) (kOf x) = x := fun x =>
      (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps (x := x) (y := iq x)).mp rfl
    rw [show hammingDist f g' = Δ.card from rfl, hgd]
    calc Δ.card ≤ ((Y.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.univ).image (fun p => fib p.1 p.2)).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card (by
          intro x hx
          refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(iq x, kOf x), ?_, hrec x⟩
          exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
            ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩)
      _ ≤ (Y.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.univ).card := Finset.card_image_le
      _ = Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
        simp only [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
          ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  have h_bridge : Code.distFromCode f C_i ≤ (d_fw * 2 ^ steps : ℕ) :=
    (distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g' hg').trans (ENat.coe_le_coe.mpr h_count)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, Code.distFromCode f C_i = (n : ℕ∞) :=
    ⟨_, (ENat.coe_toNat (by
      intro h
      rw [h] at h_bridge
      exact absurd h_bridge (not_le_of_gt (WithTop.coe_lt_top _)))).symm⟩
  rw [hn]
  show ((2 * n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) < (d_i : ℕ∞)
  refine ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (Nat.sub_lt_self Nat.one_pos h_pos))
  exact Nat.le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ENat.coe_le_coe.1 (hn ▸ h_bridge)) (Nat.zero_le 2))
    h_arith
